title: A rider on a host
hook: Some fish stay close to a larger animal.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The small remora approaches and its head disc is shown contacting the larger animal. Remoras use a modified disc on top of the head to attach to hosts; the picture is a simplified arrangement and does not measure attachment force.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: Which structure is used by a remora to attach to a host in this schematic?
